decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship product line close to the core and central to the digital-practice direction, the firm's heavy investment and visible commitment make withdrawal very unlikely, and any weak results can be attributed to the temporary disruptions of the pandemic.
The remote screen-sharing tool is a low-cost part of the support business that became more valuable during pandemic-era remote work, so there is no reason to drop it.

The analytics dashboard builds on the core software and was presented on a page of its own, and it fits the announced direction of efficiently managed, connected practices, so management will persist with it.
The complete practice bundle is essentially a packaging of the core offer for new practices and was promoted prominently, so dropping it would release little and contradict the firm's positioning.

The listing portal is distant from the core and only mentioned on the website, so it is the most likely to be dropped, but its low running costs and its role in connecting the firm's dental community make it likely to be kept for now.
